provenance.translation: Direct translation of the public Japanese guide. Original guide sources remain in its metadata.

nameChecks.ja: 予言を蔑視するでない

stageName.text: Into the Darkness, Floor 2: Tendon Bridge

lead.text: Reduce all 4 Candles to 1 HP to light them. Once the boss's normal resistances return, focus damage on it or break every lit Candle's Shield in the same turn to trigger self-damage and Stagger.

statNote.text: The enhanced-resistance and restored-resistance entries describe the same boss, retaining its 942 HP. There are 4 Candles with 26 HP each; they light at 1 HP rather than falling to 0. Breaking their 20-point Shields after lighting is a separate step. Ishmael must deploy while alive and cannot be replaced with a Support Identity. Noose assists her to Level 40 and Uptie/Threadspin IV. She begins each fight at -25 SP, so do not rely on her alone for strong opening Clashes or costly E.G.O.

priorities.0.text: Avoid triggering the boss's Counter; light all 4 Candles first.

priorities.1.text: After all are lit, choose between focusing the boss and breaking all 4 Shields in the same turn.

priorities.2.text: Do not use Paralyze to weaken negative-Coin 9:2. Manage Burn and healing instead.

troubleshooting.0.advice.text: While resistance buffs are active, all resistances are 0.5. Reduce all Candles to 1 HP to light them rather than trying to defeat them. Once all are lit, normal resistances return, making Gloom especially effective.

troubleshooting.1.symptom.text: Candles do not die at 1 HP

troubleshooting.1.advice.text: Candles light at 1 HP and cannot die. This creates an opening to attack the boss. Breaking their Shields after lighting extinguishes them next turn; these are separate steps.

troubleshooting.2.symptom.text: The area attack remains strong despite Paralyze

troubleshooting.2.advice.text: 9:2 has 20 Base Power and -4 Coin Power. Paralyze sets Coin Power to 0, preventing the usual power reduction. Use strong Clashes or extinguish every Candle instead of treating Paralyze as a debuff here.

phases.0.title.text: Prepare attacks for all 4 Candles and healing for Burn

phases.0.steps.0.text: Recommended Level 40; deploy 6 Sinners. Divide attacks so each of the 4 Candles reaches 1 HP rather than focusing everything on one.

phases.0.steps.1.text: Once normal resistances return, Gloom, Sloth, and Slash are effective. Prepare Wrath resistance and HP healing for Burn attrition too.

phases.0.steps.2.text: Ishmael starts at low SP. Consider opening recovery or defense rather than relying on her winning every Clash needed to light Candles.

phases.1.title.text: Light all 4 without triggering the boss's normal Counter

phases.1.steps.0.text: Candles light when reduced to 1 HP. Divide attacks across all 4 instead of trying to defeat them one at a time.

phases.1.steps.1.text: All Shall be Revealed and All Shall Burn are unclashable. Use Evade or other damage mitigation rather than trying to redirect them into a strong attacking Clash.

phases.1.steps.2.text: The boss also has a normal Counter during this phase. Check Attack Weight and targets when using area attacks to avoid accidentally including the boss as a secondary target.

phases.1.steps.3.text: The boss lights the Candles 4 turns after they go out. If you lack actions, you need not keep triggering its Counter unnecessarily.

phases.2.title.text: Choose between focusing the boss and extinguishing all Candles

phases.2.steps.0.text: The boss's normal resistances return and attacks can deal effective damage. If your damage is sufficient, leave Candles alone and focus the boss to Stagger it before 9:2.

phases.2.steps.1.text: Otherwise, fully deplete every Candle's 20-point Shield in the same turn. All go out next turn, triggering 6:5's self-damage and Stagger.

phases.2.steps.2.text: Splitting actions between damaging the boss and extinguishing Candles can leave you taking Counter Burn without extinguishing them all. Choose the turn's goal before assigning attacks.

phases.3.title.text: Use a strong Clash against negative Coins

phases.3.steps.0.text: 9:2 starts at 20 and loses 4 power per Coin. Paralyze removes that reduction, so do not use it to weaken this skill.

phases.3.steps.1.text: Win with a strong skill to prevent Burn and Max HP reduction on hit. However, the enemy's [Clash Lose] effect still applies 10 Burn and next-turn Marked, so victory does not mean taking no damage.

phases.3.steps.2.text: Marked targets take additional damage based on Max HP. Check HP recovery and Wrath resistance, and recover before the area attack.

phases.3.steps.3.text: Afterward, Candles heal and go out. If the boss survives, repeat the lighting process.

phases.4.timing.text: Deplete all 4 Shields in the same turn

phases.4.steps.0.text: If all Candles go out in time, the boss uses 6:5 instead of 9:2. This unclashable, unredirectable skill makes the boss take the damage itself.

phases.4.steps.1.text: Attack during the boss's Stagger next turn. Save healing and damage skills rather than attempting to Clash with the self-damaging skill using a Sinner's E.G.O.

phases.4.steps.2.text: Light the Candles again after they heal. Manage Burn buildup and repeat the process for another opening if needed.

mechanics.0.effect.text: 4 Candles with 26 HP each. They light at 1 HP rather than reaching 0; lighting all restores the boss's normal resistances. Breaking their 20-point Shields afterward extinguishes them next turn.

mechanics.0.response.text: Treat initial lighting and Shield-breaking to extinguish all Candles as separate steps.

mechanics.1.effect.text: A mark prioritized by some boss and Candle attacks. A hit from 9:2 also deals additional damage equal to 5% of Max HP.

mechanics.1.response.text: Heal the marked Sinner and protect them with strong Clashes or resistances.

mechanics.2.effect.text: A Canto V dungeon aid. Raises Ishmael to Level 40 if below 40 and assists Uptie/Threadspin to IV. Grants Compulsion each battle.

mechanics.2.response.text: Prepare other main units, resistances, and healing rather than rushing to raise only Ishmael.

mechanics.3.effect.text: Ishmael begins combat at -25 SP. At Turn Start, if SP is below 0, gain 3 Attack Power Up.

mechanics.3.response.text: Prioritize SP recovery and durability, and watch for E.G.O Corrosion at low SP.

warnings.0.text: Lit Candles use normal Counters. These cannot be stopped by winning a Clash.

warnings.1.text: Winning against 9:2 still leaves its [Clash Lose] Burn effect. Preventing hits does not cancel every effect.

warnings.2.text: To extinguish all Candles, deplete all 4 Shields in the same turn. Breaking just one does not trigger the same Stagger opening.

warnings.3.text: Enhanced-resistance and restored-resistance entries share one HP gauge. You do not defeat two separate bosses in sequence.

preparation.0.text: Prepare enough actions to light each Candle, Gloom/Sloth/Slash damage for the boss, and HP recovery.

preparation.1.text: Save a powerful answer to 9:2. Paralyze does not weaken its negative Coins.

roles.1.reason.text: Exploit restored resistances and Stagger openings.

roles.2.name.text: Actions / area attacks to extinguish all Candles

roles.2.reason.text: Break every Shield in the same turn to trigger self-damage.

roles.3.reason.text: Recover from attrition that remains even after winning the area-attack Clash.

units.0.notes.0.text: After Candles fully heal and go out, all resistances are 0.5 until every Candle is lit.

units.0.notes.1.text: Attacking the boss triggers its normal Counter. Attack Candles first.

units.0.notes.2.text: Remains targetable and can still act after Part break.

units.1.stagger.text: Retains the same boss's remaining thresholds

units.1.notes.0.text: Normal resistances after all Candles are lit: Gloom 2.0, Sloth 1.5, Slash 1.2.

units.1.notes.1.text: To extinguish all Candles, damage every Candle's Shield in the same turn.

units.1.notes.2.text: At the end of 9:2 or 6:5, Candles fully heal, their Parts revive, and the flames go out.

units.2.notes.0.text: Cannot reach 0 HP. At 1 HP, the Part breaks and lights. Acts while lit.

units.2.notes.1.text: When all are lit, uses a normal Counter with a 20-point Shield. Fully depleting the Shield extinguishes it next turn.

units.2.notes.2.text: 4 turns after the flames go out, the boss also reduces all Candles to 1 HP and lights them.

skills.0.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Deal SP damage equal to the number of lit Candles.

skills.0.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Deal SP damage equal to the number of lit Candles.

skills.0.response.text: Prioritizes Marked targets, dealing SP damage according to the lit Candle count. Stop it with a regular skill while continuing to focus damage on the boss.

skills.1.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Wrath Fragility next turn.

skills.1.effects.1.text: [On Hit] If the target has Burn, inflict 3 Burn.

skills.1.effects.2.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Wrath Fragility next turn.

skills.1.effects.3.text: [On Hit] If the target has Burn, inflict 3 Burn.

skills.1.response.text: Adds Wrath Fragility and Burn. Stop it with a strong regular skill to avoid making the following 9:2 more dangerous.

skills.2.effects.1.text: On hitting a Marked target, deal additional damage equal to 5% of Max HP.

skills.2.effects.2.text: [Clash Lose] Inflict 10 Burn. Inflict Marked on the target next turn.

skills.2.effects.3.text: [Turn End] Heal all Candles to Max HP.

skills.2.effects.4.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Reduce the target's Max HP by 10%.

skills.2.effects.5.text: [On Hit] Inflict 5 Burn and increase Burn Count by 2.

skills.2.effects.6.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Reduce the target's Max HP by 10%.

skills.2.effects.7.text: [On Hit] Inflict 5 Burn and increase Burn Count by 2.

skills.2.response.text: An area attack with 20 Base Power and two -4 Coins. Do not use Paralyze to weaken it. Even when you prevent hits by winning, the enemy's [Clash Lose] effect applies 10 Burn and Marked, so prepare healing.

skills.3.effects.1.text: Take the target's damage instead. Become Staggered next turn.

skills.3.effects.2.text: Inflict Marked next turn on a random enemy without Marked.

skills.3.effects.3.text: [Turn End] Heal all Candles to Max HP.

skills.3.effects.4.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Reduce own Max HP by 10%.

skills.3.effects.6.text: Ⅱ[On Hit] Reduce own Max HP by 10%.

skills.3.response.text: An unclashable, unredirectable self-damaging skill. Trigger it by extinguishing all Candles, then concentrate attacks during the boss's Stagger next turn.

skills.4.response.text: An unclashable Lust/Pierce attack. Prevent hits with Evade or similar options, and attack Candles without triggering the boss's Counter.

skills.5.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] If the target has Burn, inflict 3 Burn.

skills.5.response.text: Unclashable. Adds 3 Burn to targets already carrying Burn, so use Evade or HP recovery.

skills.6.effects.0.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 5 Burn and increase Burn Count by 2.

skills.6.response.text: A normal Counter triggered by attacking the boss during enhanced resistances. Light the Candles first to avoid unnecessary Burn.

skills.7.effects.1.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 6 Burn and increase Burn Count by 2.

skills.7.response.text: A lit Candle's attack. Prioritizes Marked targets and applies 6 Burn and 2 Count. Avoid leaving these attacks unchecked while working toward lighting all Candles.

skills.8.effects.1.text: When the Shield is fully depleted, the flame goes out next turn.

skills.8.effects.2.text: Ⅰ[On Hit] Inflict 1 Burn and 1 Burn Count.

skills.8.response.text: A normal Counter with a 20-point Shield. To extinguish all Candles, deplete every Shield in the same turn. Account for Burn from Counters too.

passives.0.effect.text: Every 4 turns after the flames go out, if any Candles are unlit, light all Candles and set their HP to 1.

passives.0.response.text: The boss lights the Candles. You need not wait 4 turns if you can light them sooner yourself.

passives.1.effect.text: Every 4 turns after the flames go out, if any Candles are unlit, light all Candles and set their HP to 1.

passives.1.response.text: The boss lights the Candles. You need not wait 4 turns if you can light them sooner yourself.

passives.2.effect.text: While Candles are unlit and at full HP, resistances increase until every Candle is lit. When all Candles are lit, resistances decrease.

passives.2.response.text: Distinguish universal 0.5 resistances from restored resistances, and deal damage after all Candles are lit.

passives.3.effect.text: While Candles are unlit and at full HP, resistances increase until every Candle is lit. When all Candles are lit, resistances decrease.

passives.3.response.text: Distinguish universal 0.5 resistances from restored resistances, and deal damage after all Candles are lit.

passives.4.effect.text: HP cannot reach 0. At 1 HP, the flame lights and Attack Skills are used.

passives.4.response.text: Its survival is intended. Divide only the damage needed to light each Candle.

passives.5.effect.text: Use a Defense Skill when all Candles are lit. When the Shield is fully depleted, the flame goes out next turn.

passives.5.response.text: To extinguish all Candles, divide attacks across all 4 Shields.
